request: Small shop udhaar khata: customers, what they took on credit with date, payments they made, balance owed per customer, total outstanding, remind me every Friday to collect

checklist.item: can record credit amounts and payments per customer

program:
app "Udhaar" wallet slate
table customer name text, phone text?
table credit customer ref customer, amount money, kind pick Took|Paid = Took
"Total outstanding" sum(credit.amount where kind = Took) - sum(credit.amount where kind = Paid) big
each customer sort name as c
  let bal = sum(c.credit.amount where kind = Took) - sum(c.credit.amount where kind = Paid)
  row card gap 1 tap edit c
    c.name bold grow
    bal bold color if(bal > 0, bad, good)
    button "+ Took 100" tap add credit customer = c, amount = 100, kind = Took
    button "Paid" tap add credit customer = c, amount = bal, kind = Paid
form customer, "Add customer"
describe:
Udhaar, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- customer: name: text; phone: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- credit: customer: a customer; amount: money; kind: one of Took, Paid, starts at Took. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Total outstanding", the total amount of credit where kind is Took minus the total amount of credit where kind is Paid.
- for each customer sorted by name:
  - a group; a tap opens the customer for editing:
    - text: the name of the customer.
    - text: bal.
    - a button "+ Took 100"; a tap adds a credit with customer set to the customer, amount set to 100, kind set to Took.
    - a button "Paid"; a tap adds a credit with customer set to the customer, amount set to bal, kind set to Paid.
- a form to add a customer.

request: Tasbeeh counter. I pick the target: 33, 99 or 100, and it counts taps and tells me when I reach it. Also reset button.
program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads mint
table tap
setting lim num = 33 "Count to"
let n = count(tap today)
draw width 240 tap add tap
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * (n % lim) / lim stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 48, n % lim big
  label 50, 66, "of" lim faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all tap
when n > 0 and n % lim = 0 notify "Round complete"
describe:
Tasbeeh, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- tap: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Count to": number, starts at 33.
Works out:
- n is how many tap entries today.
Shows:
- a drawing made of circles, arcs, labels; a tap adds a tap.
- a button "Reset today"; a tap removes all tap entries, with one undo.
- when n is more than 0 and n leaves over when divided by lim is 0, it shows the notice "Round complete".

request: classroom seating grid 5 rows by 6 columns where I tap a seat to put a student name in

checklist.item: shows a grid of 5 rows and 6 columns of seats
tapping a seat lets user set a student name
filled seats look different from empty ones

program:
app "Seating" seat slate
table seat cell num 1..24, name text
grid 6 gap 1
  each 1..24 as c
    box height 56 radius 8 fill if(count(seat where cell = c) > 0, accent, soft) tap add seat cell = c, name = "name"
      last(seat.name where cell = c) small align center
form seat, "Put a student at a desk"
describe:
Seating, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- seat: cell: number, 1 to 24; name: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a grid of 6 columns:
  - for each number from 1 to 24:
    - a group; a tap adds a seat with cell set to the number, name set to "name":
      - text: the latest name of seat where cell is the number.
- a form to add a seat.

request: We are shifting house next month. Track boxes by room (kitchen, bedroom, kids room, living, store) with a label of what is inside and whether it is packed. Would be great if my wife and I could both see it on our phones and sync live.

checklist.item: can add a box with room (pick) and contents label
box has a packed yes/no tick
shows count of boxes packed vs total
list grouped or filtered by room

program:
app "Moving" box ocean
table place name text, room pick Kitchen|Bedroom|Kids|Living|Store = Kitchen, packed bool
"Packed" count(place where packed = yes) "of" count(place) big
each options place.room as r
  stack card gap 1
    row
      r bold grow
      count(place where room = r) faint
    each place where room = r as p
      row tap edit p
        p.name grow
        toggle p.packed
form place, "Add item"
describe:
Moving, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- place: name: text; room: one of Kitchen, Bedroom, Kids, Living, Store, starts at Kitchen; packed: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Packed", how many place entries where packed is yes, "of", how many place entries.
- for each choice of the room of the place:
  - text: the choice.
  - text: how many place entries where room is the choice.
  - for each place where room is the choice:
    - a group; a tap opens the place for editing:
      - text: the name of the place.
      - a tick box for the packed of the place.
- a form to add a place.

request: goat feed log. 6 goats. daily: fodder kg, wanda (concentrate) kg, cost. also a vaccination date list

checklist.item: can add a daily feed entry with fodder kg, concentrate kg and cost
has a place to record vaccination dates

program:
app "Goat" paw mint
table goat name text, vaccinated date
table feed goat ref goat, ministration num 10..300 = 60
table vaccine goat ref goat, name text, given date
remind "A goat vaccine is due" at vaccine.given
each goat as g
  stack card gap 1 tap edit g
    g.name bold
    if due(g.feed, 30)
      "Feed started" color warn
    else
      "Vaccinated" g.vaccinated color good
    "Last dose" last(g.feed.ministration) "min" faint
form goat, "Add goat"
form feed, "Log milk"
form vaccine, "Add vaccine"
describe:
Goat, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- goat: name: text; vaccinated: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- feed: goat: a goat; ministration: number, 10 to 300, starts at 60. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- vaccine: goat: a goat; name: text; given: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each goat:
  - a group; a tap opens the goat for editing:
    - text: the name of the goat.
    - if the goat's feed entries is due: never done, or 30 days or more since the last:
      - text: "Feed started".
    - otherwise:
      - text: "Vaccinated", the vaccinated of the goat.
    - text: "Last dose", the latest ministration of the goat's feed entries, "min".
- a form to add a goat.
- a form to add a feed.
- a form to add a vaccine.
Reminder "A goat vaccine is due" on each given of the vaccine entries.

request: monthly budget as a fuel gauge, add spends and the needle goes down. budget 50000

checklist.item: has a gauge or bar showing remaining budget out of 50000
can add a spend with amount and note

program:
app "Fuel" car mint
table refuel litres num 1..120 unit "L"
setting cost money = 5000 "Petrol cost per litre"
let litres = sum(refuel.litres month)
"Monthly budget" round(litres * cost) big
"Spent this month" sum(refuel.litres month) * cost faint
"Last month" sum(refuel.litres prev month) * cost faint
form refuel, "Add expense"
list refuel
describe:
Fuel, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- refuel: litres: number, 1 to 120, in L. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Petrol cost per litre": money, starts at 5000.
Works out:
- litres is the total litres of refuel this month.
Shows:
- text: "Monthly budget", litres times cost rounded.
- text: "Spent this month", the total litres of refuel this month times cost.
- text: "Last month", the total litres of refuel last month times cost.
- a form to add a refuel.
- a list of refuel; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
